summary: Dependency resolved from mutable non-registry URL enables install-time code delivery
details: @bx-ui-framework/common@15.0.0 declares a dependency `common` pointing at the arbitrary URL https://repo.artifactorymanager.com/bx-ui-framework/common, outside the npm registry and with no version pin or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever tarball is served at that URL into the installer's dependency tree. The top-level package itself is nearly empty (a `hello()` function returning "ok"), and its public scoped name mirrors what appears to be an internal artifact path, matching a dependency-confusion / mutable-URL lure shape. The host controls what code lands on the installer's machine at install time, and can change it at any moment without republishing this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
